name: useADPF
summary: How much thermal room is left before the phone slows itself down.
plain: Warns you before the phone gets hot enough to throttle. Check thermalHeadroom before starting sustained work such as camera capture or a long inference run, and back off as it climbs toward 1.
description: thermalHeadroom comes from PowerManager.getThermalHeadroom and is sampled every ten seconds. A live thermal-status listener reports the coarse state from NONE through SHUTDOWN. Android 16+ SystemHealthManager CPU/GPU headroom estimates available compute capacity (0..1 after scaling its 0..100 result); it is not thermal headroom or utilization. Android can return NaN with insufficient workload or a transient server error, or throw if a device does not implement it. The unavailable-reason fields distinguish those outcomes, pending reads and API absence. Frame figures pair the display mode refresh rate as a target with the Choreographer-measured rate as the actual. Battery-pack temperature is available separately through useDevice; an FIR object thermometer reading cannot be substituted for it.

returns.name: thermalHeadroom
returns.desc: 0 is cool, 1 means throttling is imminent. The single number to gate heavy work on.

returns.name: thermalThresholds
returns.desc: Headroom values at which this specific device enters each thermal status.

returns.name: thermalStatus
returns.desc: Coarse state, updated by a system listener rather than polling.

returns.name: thermalStatusCode
returns.desc: Raw PowerManager constant behind that label.

returns.name: cpuHeadroom
returns.desc: Android 16+ available CPU capacity fraction (0..1), not thermal headroom or utilization; null when unmeasured.

returns.name: gpuHeadroom
returns.desc: Android 16+ available GPU capacity fraction (0..1), not GPU utilization; null when unmeasured.

returns.name: cpuHeadroomUnavailableReason
returns.desc: Null with a measured CPU estimate; otherwise distinguishes missing API, unsupported device, temporary NaN (including insufficient workload), failed read or no sample yet.

returns.name: gpuHeadroomUnavailableReason
returns.desc: Null with a measured GPU estimate; otherwise the same availability categories as CPU.

returns.name: targetFps
returns.desc: Refresh rate of the current display mode.

returns.name: currentFps
returns.desc: Frames actually presented, measured by Choreographer.

returns.name: source
returns.desc: Where the numbers came from. There is no 'simulated' value: a reading is real, derived from real readings, or unavailable.

actions.name: reportWorkDuration(actualMs, targetMs?)
actions.desc: Pure helper that judges a measured piece of work against the frame budget. It computes a verdict for your own scheduling; it does not call the platform performance hint system.

inputs.name: actualWorkDurationMs
inputs.desc: How long the work you just did actually took, in milliseconds.

inputs.name: targetDurationMs
inputs.desc: Budget to judge it against. Defaults to 1000 / targetFps, or 8.33 ms before the refresh rate has been read.

actions.output: 'WITHIN_BUDGET' when the work fits the frame, 'BOOST_REQUESTED' when it overran and you should shed work.

agentNote: Gate sustained workloads on thermalHeadroom, not on thermalStatus alone; the number moves before the label does.
